New research project `research/sleeping-ledger` (MIT, stdlib-only Python, 8 tests, white paper, experiments), plus README and portfolio page entries.

Sleeping-experts wealth market for modular/continual-learning routing: exact budget balance, frozen sleeping wealth, regret in a module's own awake time, entry cost of a new module, and comparison with forced-to-report Hedge and fixed share on recurring regimes. Bound looseness is reported honestly.
